context_purpose: The library issues a children's card only to a parent or legal guardian who can answer for the child's loans.

norm_violation_today.reason: A library needs only guardian status, not the court findings, parents' details or the child's record shown on the order or register.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; the library cannot check the guardianship basis or duration, which it does not need for a card.

transmission_check.reason: The guardian hands over documents voluntarily to get a service, and no rule I know of obliges a library to keep the full order.

context_purpose: The market committee confirms each vendor setting up has a valid food-hygiene and stall permit before trading.

norm_violation_today.reason: Checking the permit is within the committee's role, but a typed-up spreadsheet of names, addresses and categories goes beyond a daily pass/fail need unless a lease or stall record is legitimately required.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The committee could not tie a named vendor to a stall, handle disputes or keep a record for lease management if it needs one.

transmission_check.reason: Food-safety regulators may require inspection records or stall assignments, and I cannot say whether a committee's own log is mandated.

context_purpose: Carpool members want reasonable assurance that a stranger sharing an early-morning car poses no violent risk.

norm_violation_today.reason: A selfie with ID and a police record screenshot placed in a shared drive reaches every member and a cloud provider, far beyond the driver's need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A one-time non-membership check says nothing about later behaviour and cannot reveal repeat complaints across groups, which a full record or reputation system could.

transmission_check.reason: The organiser has no legal duty to collect this, so a narrower proof is allowed, though a suitable police-backed issuer is the real obstacle.

context_purpose: The temple wants assurance that a volunteer working with primary-school children has no child-related or fraud conviction.

norm_violation_today.reason: The whole certificate with unrelated old entries, ID number and address is kept indefinitely when a listed/not-listed answer would serve.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A non-membership claim cannot show convictions outside the register's categories, so the temple loses discretion over borderline cases it might have wanted to judge.

transmission_check.reason: Child-protection rules may require certain organisations to see a certificate, and I cannot confirm whether a temple programme is covered.

context_purpose: The scholarship office confirms an applicant has recognised indigenous status to award a status-restricted tuition benefit.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full household transcript exposes parents, address and marital history when only the status is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: If the scholarship needs the specific people for quotas or reports, the status flag alone is not enough and a second attribute must be disclosed.

transmission_check.reason: The applicant volunteers documents for a benefit, but audit rules may require the school to keep a copy and I cannot say whether a presentation record would count.

context_purpose: The guesthouse owner verifies a group really belongs to the temple before granting a pilgrim group rate.

norm_violation_today.reason: Photos of ID cards, believer cards and a roster over LINE kept on a personal phone reveal religion and identity beyond a discount check.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for the discount; the owner still needs ordinary lodging identity records separately.

transmission_check.reason: The discount check is voluntary, but lodging registration may legally require identity records, and I cannot say what is required of a small guesthouse.

context_purpose: The landlord decides whether to waive an early-termination penalty because the tenant is protected by a current court order.

norm_violation_today.reason: The landlord receives the abuser's name, allegations, children's names and old address, and may keep a photocopy, none of which bears on the lease.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little; the landlord cannot verify the case details, but does not need them.

transmission_check.reason: The tenant volunteers the order to obtain a lease waiver and no law I know of requires the landlord to hold the full order.

context_purpose: The broker confirms travellers qualify for an affinity-group rate and collects the fields needed to issue the group policy.

norm_violation_today.reason: A roster naming the congregation reveals religion, but the group rate may legitimately depend on that affinity and the policy may name the group anyway.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The insurer may need the group name on the policy or a roster for claims, which a membership proof alone does not provide.

transmission_check.reason: The affinity proof is a business choice, but insurance regulation may require identity fields and a traveller list, and I cannot say what applies.
